programme.title: The Best of The Adventures
programme.desc: 1981. Comedy. Directed by Stanley Long. Stars Barry Evans, Harry H. Corbett & Diana Dors. The funniest, naughtiest bits from the 1970s Adventures of series. Bawdy British fun at its cheekiest.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Man In The Attic
programme.desc: 1953. Thriller. Director: Hugo Fregonese. Stars Jack Palance, Constance Smith & Byron Palmer. A landlady suspects her new tenant is Jack the Ripper when a self-described pathologist moves in.

programme.title: Beat The Devil
programme.desc: 1953. Adventure. Director: John Huston. Stars Humphrey Bogart, Gina Lollobrigida & Jennifer Jones. A group of rogues headed to Africa, in hopes of claiming valuable land, get stranded in Italy.

programme.title: Star Performance: The Collar
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by Roy Kellino. Stars David Niven, Barton MacLane & Walter Coy. A priest, held captive by a tribe, attempts to save their lives after they are threatened by the military.

programme.title: Carnival in Munich 1956
programme.desc: 1956. A fascinating travelogue walking through all there is to see and do at a carnival held every September in Munich.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Blackmail. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Bernadette O'Farrell & Ian Hunter. A stranger attempts to blackmail Robin after overhearing an important conversation he had with Lady Marian.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: Pirate Plunder. 1961. Stars David Graham, Graydon Gould & George Murcell. The team get involved in a sting operation to capture the pirate Black Morgan, who is operating in the Pacific Ocean.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Ring of Greed. 1955. Stars Megs Jenkins, Clifford Evans & Betty Anne Davis. Margaret and Frank fell in love at first sight but will Margaret manage to escape from a fate that is unknown to her?

programme.title: Murder in Eden
programme.desc: 1961. Thriller. Director: Max Varnel. Stars: Ray McAnally, Catherine Feller, Yvonne Buckingham. After discovering a famous painting is a forgery, a noted art critic is killed by driver.

programme.title: The Trial of Madame X
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Directed by Paul England. Stars Mara Russell-Tavernan, Frank Hawkins & Edward Leslie. A philandering wife thrown out of home by her husband later finds herself accused of murder.

programme.title: The Angel Who Pawned Her Harp
programme.desc: 1954. Drama starring Felix Aylmer, Diane Cilento and Jerry Desmond. A beautiful angel is sent to The Angel, London, to help people with problems, but she has no money to support herself.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Eviction. 1975. Stars Paul Barber, John Kane & John Collin. With Quilley in hospital, Lynch's attitude to the squatters hardens - but is the security firm entirely blameless?

programme.title: The Child and the Killer
programme.desc: 1959. Crime. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Patricia Driscoll, Robert Arden & Richard Williams. A US army officer goes on the run after committing murder and orders a young boy to help him to safety.

programme.title: The English Riviera in 1957
programme.desc: 1957. Let's take a trip down to the sea in this charming reel of the captivating English Riviera, with a tour of the picturesque towns and villages along the Cornish coastline.

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Little People of Lyntor. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Roy Kinnear & Jack Smethurst. Richard finds out taxpayers have been tricked by false documents backed by Prince John's soldiers.

programme.title: Noose
programme.desc: 1948. Crime drama starring Derek Farr, Carole Landis & Stanley Holloway. Sugiani, a black-market racketeer (Joseph Calleia), is amassing a fortune until reporter Linda Medbury is on to him.

programme.title: Naked Fury
programme.desc: 1959. After a robbery during which the night-watchman is killed, the robbers take his daughter hostage. Stars Kenneth Cope & Reed de Rouen.

programme.title: The Lamp Still Burns
programme.desc: 1943. Drama. Director: Maurice Elvey. Stars Rosamund John, Stewart Granger, Godfrey Tearle. Architect Hilary Clark decides to become a nurse. Follow her battle between her heart and her vocation.

programme.title: Scales of Justice

programme.desc: Minerva, Mayhem and Millionaires. 1968. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Zsa Zsa Gabor. Minerva has been using a ''Deepest Secret Extractor'' to find where her customers hide their valuables.

programme.title: The Night Caller
programme.desc: 1965. Sci-Fi. Director: John Gilling. Stars John Saxon, Maurice Denham and Patricia Haines. Aliens need to find mates from another world or they'll become extinct, they start with earth females.

programme.title: Look At Life Under Your Feet
programme.desc: 1960. Beneath our feet is a little-seen world. This film reveals the labyrinth of London's sewers, an Aladdin's cave of silver, and the GPO's unique tube railway.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: Moving In. 1985. Stars Mollie Sugden, Christopher Blake & Deddie Davies. The family make their way to Yorkshire, but the journey proves to be exceptionally troublesome.

programme.title: For the Love of Ada
programme.desc: A Lunchtime Drink. Stars: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. Walter and Leslie sneak off to the pub for a Sunday drink, to Ruth and Ada's disapproval. (S3, E05)

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Yukon Affair. 1965. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & George Sanders. G. Emory Partridge returns with a plot to disrupt world communications. Solo and Illya travel to Alaska to stop him.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: This week, enjoy a reel on leaving school and finding a job in 1950s Yorkshire! Jean Muir is here to persuade you to part with your shillings, Tufty has some sound advice and visit 1950s Slough!

programme.title: Enemy At The Door
programme.desc: V For Victory. 1978. Stars: Alfred Burke, Bernard Horsfall & Emily Richard. After cut-out blue paper V for Victory signs appear in library books, somebody takes to painting V signs on walls.

programme.title: Look At Life The Wall
programme.desc: 1962. A look at Hadrian's Wall in Northumberland. Also, with a look at a more detailed examination of the Berlin Wall.

programme.title: A Nice Little Bank That Should Be Robbed
programme.desc: 1958. Comedy. Director: Henry Levin. Stars Tom Ewell & Mickey Rooney. Two crooks rob a bank to buy a racehorse but realise they have to continue robbing banks to support it.

programme.title: Fox
programme.desc: Shim-Me-Sha-Wabble. 1980. Stars Peter Vaughan, Ray Winstone & Eve Bland. A grief-stricken Kenny leaves London and meets with the seemingly helpful Rita. Meanwhile, his brothers try to find him.

programme.title: French Connection II
programme.desc: 1975. Crime Drama. Director: John Frankenheimer. Stars Gene Hackman, Fernando Rey & Bernard Fresson. Narcotics detective Doyle travels to France to hunt the ringleader who eluded him in New York.
